note: Task import now reads Actual Start / Actual Finish and % Complete from your Excel/CSV (MS Project "NA" = blank; fractions like 0.81 become 81%), and sets each task's status from its progress (0 = To-do, 1-99 = In-progress, 100 = Done). A "Finish" column is now recognised as the end date too. Also this week: Allocation Register usage filter, kept scroll position on log edits, and searchable allocation pickers.
